# Choose a candidate that fits open fingers
valid_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]
candidate = valid_candidates[0] if valid_candidates else candidates[0]
grasp_res = grasp(candidate)

# Check holding
if grasp_res.get("holding_something", False):
    obs = observe()
    holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
    hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
    rim_height = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)
    table_z = obs["table_z"]

    # Carry above the holder, safely above the rim
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_height + 0.15)

    # To place upright into the holder, orient the pen vertically.
    # Currently approach=[0, 0, -1]. The pen lies along side (approach x finger_axis).
    # Turning approach horizontal will align the pen (side) vertically.
    # Approach along world x or y, e.g. approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0] gives side = [0, 0, 1] (vertical).
    move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + rim_height + 0.12, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="line")

    # Lower slightly into the holder
    move_by(dz=-0.04)

    # Release the pen
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)

go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
